entries.feb69621b3261b6f: The company's corporate philosophy is “to contribute to society by raising customer trust through safe and reliable execution of operations in a customer-first spirit, and by creating socially important infrastructure that supports people's lives and the economy,” and it treats safety as the most important issue in its management. In railway electrical construction it aims to secure orders from JR companies, led by its largest customer East Japan Railway Company; in general electrical construction, to pursue sales around large station-area redevelopments and data centers; in information and communications construction, to expand base station construction and infrastructure sharing business; and in environmental and energy construction, to propose renewable energy based on its ZEB technical capabilities; and it has set consolidated revenue of ¥242.3 billion as its management target for the fiscal year ending March 2027.
